tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one square 3 by 3 production sprite sheet, NINE poses of exactly the same simplified Atlantic puffin bird prop in image1. Highest available native resolution. Real transparent RGBA background, no floor, labels, text, borders, grid lines, props, clouds, sparkles, or other animals. Image1 is the identity and style reference, not an edit target. Redraw fresh in precisely its rounded simple children's watercolor cut-paper world: large clean color blocks, subtle pale paper texture, warm brown contour, one simple solid brown dot for each visible eye, cream-white cheek/belly, charcoal cap/back/wing, blunt orange/yellow/gray striped bill and short orange webbed feet. Keep broad simplified wings, not anatomical feather diagrams. The bird remains a bird-like prop, not a humanoid with hands, arms, clothes, giant expressive anime eyes, teeth or human mouth. No extra limbs, no detailed feather barbs. Full bird in every cell with wide transparent separation and no overlap or clipped bill/wing/feet/tail. All nine cells keep the SAME anatomical head and body size and proportions, even when tilting or lifting wings; only stance/gaze/gesture changes. ROW-MAJOR ORDER: 1 BLINK: reference's calm standing profile with eye gently closed as a simple curved brown stroke; two grounded webbed feet. 2 GREET: grounded bird gently raises its near wing in a friendly small greeting, same body scale and dot eye. 3 PRESENT LEFT: grounded bird directs its bill and near wing toward viewer LEFT as if indicating a number offscreen, connected wing attachment. 4 PRESENT RIGHT: grounded bird turns its head/body naturally toward viewer RIGHT and directs bill/wing that way; preserve bill bands and cap/cheek patches, do not merely flip asymmetric wing anatomy. 5 THINK: grounded bird with gently tilted head and bill slightly down in a curious pondering pose, near wing resting, solid dot eye. 6 AHA: bird perks head up, near wing a little lifted, dot eye, alert friendly discovery; no lightbulb/effect. 7 CHEER: grounded pleased puffin lifts both small wings comfortably, feet intact, dot eyes and same palette. 8 SPECIES A: small flying key pose with broad rounded wings lifted UP and both short feet tucked; same body/head scale. 9 SPECIES B: complementary flying pose with wings DOWN/outward and feet tucked; same torso/head scale and clear wing connections. Keep the flying bird at comparable position in its cell and leave extra transparent margin around wings. Carefully clean connected silhouettes, no stray pigment, smudges, doubled bills/wings, missing feet, halos, gradients spilling outside or photographic realism. No extra neutral pose.
